title: Khai báo các nấc lưu lượng Canary trong Argo Rollouts
code:
strategy:
  canary:
    steps:
      - setWeight: 5
      - pause: { duration: "2m" }
      - setWeight: 25
      - setWeight: 100

title: Job Rollback tự động khi Smoke Test thất bại
code:
rollback:
  needs: [deploy-prod, smoke-test]
  if: failure()
  runs-on: ubuntu-latest
  steps:
    - run: ./scripts/rollback.sh
